name: Drama Club
body:
Aura moderate enchantment; CL 9; Weight 3 lbs.; Price 18,300 gp

DESCRIPTION

If this +1 club lands a critical hit and the wielder’s CMB+20 is equal to or greater than the target’s CMD, the target is knocked down and back 2d10 feet. Anyone carrying this weapon also has very emotional interactions with others, either gaining a +4 bonus to Diplomacy checks, or suffering a – 4 penalty to Diplomacy checks. There is a 50% chance of either one happening in any given situation. Once per day the drama club can also be used to cast the spell contumacy.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells contumacy; Cost 9,150 gp
